## Finance » Payment Gateways » Additional Settings » Billing Address Countries
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047893
This section controls the active and featured countries displayed on paid checkout pages.
Here it is possible to modify the countries that display in paid sig- up forms and choose which countries are displayed or not:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091457115/original/5jtXqRgZOyRpvNu1OQEIrCCPuhtwIik9Mg.png?1618607024 | alt: ]
In order to select which countries to display on the section above, go to Finance » Payment Gateways » Additional Settings » Billing Address Countries
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12172226904/original/On2_Vi14LbOdd0o6Pa_ucpnsNJbNbF8lHw.png?1766170793 | alt: ]
A new page will open where the Active, Featured and Not Active Countries can be selected:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12172226957/original/htjOsAPjubFZ6MSrKGX2JFaZooSPyjiOPQ.png?1766170866 | alt: ]
Not Active (The country is not going to display as an option on the Sign-Up / Checkout Page)
Active (The country is going to display as an option on the Sign Up / Checkout Page)
Featured (The country will show up first and so on, on the list)
